description: SMART-QSO uplink command dictionary (SQSO-ICD-013 section 7). Single source for software/rust/sqso-protocol/src/dictionary.rs and software/ground/tools/command_dictionary.py; regenerate with scripts/gen_command_dictionary.py. key: which telecommand key authenticates the command (operational, recovery, or any). without_key: accepted without authentication only while no key is usable (TX-OFF can only reduce emissions).

commands.name: NOP
commands.summary: No operation

commands.name: RESET
commands.summary: System reset (logged only until a hardware reset exists)

commands.name: SET_MODE
commands.summary: Set mode through the transition table: 0 SAFE, 1 IDLE, 2 ACTIVE

commands.name: GET_STATUS
commands.summary: Get system status (4 bytes)

commands.name: SET_CONTACT_TIMEOUT
commands.summary: Set the loss-of-contact timeout, days big-endian, 1 to 90 (default 30 at launch, 14 after commissioning: decision D3)

commands.name: CLEAR_FAULTS
commands.summary: Clear fault log

commands.name: KEY_ROTATE
commands.summary: Activate spare operational key slot 0-3 and revoke the current key (recovery key only)

commands.name: EPS_SET_MODE
commands.summary: Set power mode: 0 SAFE, 1 IDLE, 2 ACTIVE

commands.name: EPS_GET_TELEMETRY
commands.summary: Get EPS telemetry

commands.name: ADCS_DETUMBLE
commands.summary: Start detumble

commands.name: ADCS_GET_ATTITUDE
commands.summary: Get attitude

commands.name: SET_BEACON
commands.summary: Set beacon interval, seconds big-endian, 10 to 120

commands.name: TX_ENABLE
commands.summary: Clear the latched TX-OFF

commands.name: TX_DISABLE
commands.summary: Latch TX-OFF in every state (47 CFR 97.207(b))

commands.name: SET_POWER
commands.summary: Set downlink power: 0 = 0.5 W, 1 = 1 W (applied by the downlink, downlink.h)

commands.name: PLD_ENABLE
commands.summary: Enable payload

commands.name: PLD_DISABLE
commands.summary: Disable payload

commands.name: COMMISSIONING_RELEASE
commands.summary: Release the commissioning hold set by ARM_FLIGHT: ACTIVE, the payload and the transponder become possible (send after TX-OFF has been proven)

commands.name: GET_HOUSEKEEPING
commands.summary: Downlink a housekeeping frame (HK1) at the next opportunity

commands.name: XPDR_ENABLE
commands.summary: Allow the FM transponder (persisted); its power and duty gates still apply

commands.name: XPDR_DISABLE
commands.summary: Stop the FM transponder (persisted); beacon and telecommand unaffected

commands.name: DEPLOY_RETRY
commands.summary: Retry a deployment element with fresh attempts: 0 antenna, 1 solar wings (refused during the 30-minute wait and during a burn)

commands.name: GNSS_REQUEST
commands.summary: Start a GNSS receiver session now (its power gates still apply)

commands.name: ADCS_SET_GEOMETRY
commands.summary: Spin axis and inertia for the attitude control (persisted): 0 both wings, 1 wing W1 only, 2 wing W2 only, 3 no wing
